name: Nuvoton Technology Corporation
summary: Nuvoton Technology Corporation, a semiconductor company, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, and sale of integrated circuits (ICs) in Taiwan and internationally. It offers 6-inch wafers; microcontrollers; microprocessors; analog ICs, application specific SoCs, battery management, cloud computing, DSP / ISPs, image sensors, laser diodes, MOSFET, motor drivers, motor microcontroller, smart home audio, power management, GUI solution, IoT solution, and optical transceiver solutions. The company also provides software and tools. Its products are used in mobility, artificial intelligence, networking, motor, power and energy, automotive, computing, medical, portable devices, …
